## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 4 окт. 2026 г. - 5 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Valentin Lopez_, 5 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "App not working just keeps refreshing. Paid a subscription for nothing if it doesn't work."
            2. _leslie cowan_, 4 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "I canceled the trial, but was still charged"
            3. _Lucienne Dadouch_, 5 окт. 2026 г., 2/5: "upgraded to premium but can't log in with my google account (premium account). Annoying."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 6 мая 2026 г. - 5 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _James Steward_, 5 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "App constantly freezing after modying daily entries. Regular popups prompting to subscribe whenever the app is opened. Dozens of duplicates of food items with incorrect macros, no proper administration done to ensure entries are correct."
            2. _Thorsten Mootz_, 30 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            3. _Harun_, 4 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
